rawContent: The level of existential despair I've been feeling lately as we watch the first phase of the #ClimateCrisis unfold is really beyond words. And this is only the very beginning. #ClimateEmergency #ClimateBreakdown #ClimateJustice #GlobalWarming

@GretaThunberg Greta --- thank you for all your tireless work to bring awareness about the #ClimateCrisis. I am an adult and I have learned a lot from you. A child/adolescent shouldn't *have* to do the work you've done and continue to do. Still, I am grateful for the sacrifices you have made.

Y'all. The 6th #ipcc report was just released. Take some time to read it (even though it's over 3,000 pages!). It's bleak. #IPCCreport #IPCCReport2021 #ClimateCrisis #ClimateEmergency #ClimateReport #ClimateCrisisIsHere
